Commentary.Commentary: Right then, Sune Luus, the victorious skipper collects the Tri-Series trophy and celebrates with her team. This ends our coverage for this series and both teams will now head on to play a couple of warm-up matches before the ICC Women's T20 World 2023 that will begin on the 10th of February with hosts South Africa Women taking on Sri Lanka Women in the opening fixture. Till then, take care and goodbye!

The South Africa Women's captain, Sune Luus says that she is super proud of the girls and it was just the momentum they needed heading into the World Cup. Adds that it was out and out a spinning wicket but all bowlers bowled well and applauds the efforts of Chloe Tryon. Mentions that she is happy overall and their fielding coach will be happy as well and they try to improve every day.

Deepti Sharma is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES. She says that she bowled according to the situation and went with a set plan in the tournament. Adds that the wicket was turning and assisting the spinners. Closes by saying that she is looking forward to the mega event.

Chloe Tryon is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her superb all-round match-winning performance. Tryon says that it was a good game and the bowlers did really well up front and is happy to have contributed with the bat as well. Adds that they did well as a team and will take this confidence heading into the World Cup.

The Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur says that her body is fine and it shall get better in the next 2-3 days. Adds that they have a lot of positives before the World Cup. She then lauds the bowlers who did a good job throughout the series. Closes by saying that she is looking forward to the World Cup.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Harmanpreet Kaur won the toss and opted to bat first on a difficult wicket. The Indian openers failed to make an impression as Nonkululeko Mlaba bowled a superb spell upfront for South Africa Women. She was well supported by Shabnim Ismail at the other end and it was then a steady stand between Harmanpreet Kaur and Harleen Deol. Kaur fell looking to up the ante but Deol carried on and received some support from Deepti Sharma. The pair of them managed to take India to a score of 109 runs. The runs on the board weren't much for South Africa Women to chase down but India Women had quality spinners in their ranks. India did have the upper hand for most of the chase before a special knock from Chloe Tryon (57* off just 32 balls) turned the game on its head and the hosts ended up winning the Tri-Series.

India Women will be a bit disappointed with their effort with both the bat and in the field as well. Having put up an under-par total on the board, it was the spin trio of Deepti Sharma, Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Sneh Rana who had the opposition in early trouble. The decision to bowl most of their overs upfront came back to haunt India as the pacers were taken to the cleaners and Devika Vaidya, the other spinner could bolw just the solo over for 12 runs. The regular too endured a bit of stick toward the end but it was really their batters and the pacers who let the final slip out of their grasp.

South Africa Women were always behind in the run chase as their openers were rattled early by the Indian spinners. Being 21/3 and not a single batter having gone into double-figures, it was the gritty stand between captain and vice-captain, Sune Luus and Chloe Tryon worth 26 runs that provided a bit of impetus. It wasn't a big stand by any means but it was a start and then another small stand brewed between Tryon and Annerie Dercksen. But they were once again reeling at 66/5 when Nadine de Klerk came out to support Tryon. The pair put on an unbeaten stand of 47 runs with Tryon notching up her maiden T20I fifty as well and sealing the win for the hosts.

What a dramatic finish to the game and the crowd inside the stadium goes wild. A cracker-jack of a final but it is Chloe Tryon and South Africa Women who have avenged their loss from the group stages to win the Tri-Series in fine fashion.

Fuller on off, Nadine de Klerk drives it through covers for one.
Flatter outside off, Nadine de Klerk goes back and works it to short third for none.
FOUR! BANG! Nadine de Klerk takes it on the full and clubs it wide of the long-on fielder for a boundary.
Sneh Rana (3-0-8-2) is back on.
Fuller ball on the leg peg. Nadine de Klerk sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for one.
Chloe Tryon takes it on the full and hits it wide of the long-on fielder for a single. Chloe Tryon brings up her maiden T20I FIFTY in the big game.
Fuller on off, Nadine de Klerk drops it to covers and scampers for a quick single.
Fuller ball on the middle and leg, Chloe Tryon bunts it down to long-on for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk whips it across the line to deep mid-wicket for one.
Drifter down the leg, Nadine de Klerk pulls it straight to short fine leg fielder.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad (3-0-20-1) to bowl out now.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single to end the over. Just 15 runs are needed now.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Chloe Tryon whips it down to long on for one.

Quicker delivery on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk bunts it past the bowler to mid-off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Nadine de Klerk goes back and guides it past the short third fielder for another two.
Floated outside off, Nadine de Klerk drives it past the cover fielder wide of the long-off region for a couple.
Deepti Sharma (3-1-6-1) is back on to finish her spell.
Back of a length down the leg, Chloe Tryon tucks it to wide of the fine leg fielder and scampers for a couple. 14 coming off that over.
FOUR! Fuller delivery on the stumps, Chloe Tryon goes hard and hits it down the ground past the long-on fielder as the ball races to the fence for four.
Fuller ball outside off, Nadine de Klerk drives it to deep covers for one.
Fuller-length around off, Chloe Tryon pushes it to point and an excellent fielding effort keeps it to one.
Back of a length delivery on the leg peg. Chloe Tryon tucks it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
FOUR!! Back of a length outside off, Chloe Tryon goes back and carves it through covers as the ball races to the fence for four. Exquisite timing.
Pooja Vastrakar (1-0-4-0) switches ends now.
Flatter on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk goes back and punches it to covers. An excellent over from Sneh Rana, just 2 runs and a wicket off it.
Tossed up outside off, Nadine de Klerk presses forward and plays it to the point region.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Nadine de Klerk looks to run it down but misses.
Chloe Tryon plays with the turn and bunts it down to long-on for one.
Drifter into the batter, Nadine de Klerk tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Nadine de Klerk walks out to bat next.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal for Annerie Dercksen. Flatter delivery coming into the batter, Annerie Dercksen looks to tuck it away on the onside but the ball stops on her and she gets a leading edge as the ball loops up in the air. Sneh Rana runs around and takes the catch off her own bowling. Huge blow for South Africa Women as Annerie Dercksen was looking good in her little knock.
Sneh Rana (2-0-6-1) is back on.
FOUR! Back of a length on the stumps, Chloe Tryon picks up the slower ball and pulls it away to the deep square leg region for another boundary in the over. 44 needed now off 42 balls.
Fuller ball on the leg stump, Annerie Dercksen clips it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! BANG! Back of a length ball angling into the batter, Annerie Dercksen carves it away to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Excellent hit by Annerie Dercksen.
Fuller on the stumps, Chloe Tryon drives it down the ground for a single. Harmanpreet Kaur runs around quickly and keeps it to one.
Slower off-cutter outside the off stump line. Chloe Tryon goes back and pulls it in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long-on for a couple.
Fuller-length nipping into the batter, Chloe Tryon plays the wrong line and gets an inside edge onto her back knee.
A low full toss on the stumps, Chloe Tryon works it to covers for a single. Annerie Dercksen tries to run on the overthrow but is sent back.
Short of a length outside off, Annerie Dercksen advances and clubs it down to long-on for a single.
Full and outside off, Chloe Tryon pushes it to deep extra covers for one.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Annerie Dercksen bunts it down to long-on for one.

Back of a length ball angling into the batter, Annerie Dercksen looks to pull and wears on the pad. The ball deflects off her pads to the point fielder who has a shy at the stump on the non-striker's end and scores a direct hit. Chloe Tryon though manages to get back inside the crease and the ball deflects off the stumps allowing the batter to take two leg byes as overthrows.
Fuller ball on off, Annerie Dercksen drives it on the up to mid-off.
Pooja Vastrakar is now brought into the attack as Harmanpreet Kaur seems to be back on the field as well.
Length ball on the pads, Annerie Dercksen tucks it to the square leg region for one.
Length ball on the stumps, Annerie Dercksen looks to tuck it away and gets an inside edge onto her thigh pad.
Fuller delivery on the pads, Annerie Dercksen looks to flick it but misses and wears it on the front pad.
The throw from the keeper has hit Annerie Dercksen on the helmet and a mandatory concussion check is carried out. Everything seems fine though and we are good to continue.

Fuller ball angling down the leg. Annerie Dercksen misses the flick as the ball brushes her pads on the way. Yastika Bhatia behind the stumps collects it and has a shy at the stumps but misses. A direct hit and Dercksen was gone.
Annerie Dercksen is the new batter in.

OUT! GONE! Very full and slower one on the stumps, Sune Luus looks to flick on the onside and gets a leading edge as the ball pops up to Deepti Sharma around the backward point region and she takes a simple catch to dismiss the South Africa Women skipper Sune Luus for 12.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length on off, Chloe Tryon pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter on the middle stump line. Sune Luus drops it to the onside.
Fuller outside off, Chloe Tryon drills it down to long-on for one.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Tad short outside off, Chloe Tryon goes back and clubs it through the cow corner region for a brilliant boundary.

Slight halt in the play as Harmanpreet Kaur is feeling a bit of pain in the left arm. The physio is out to have a look and the umpires take this opportunity to call for drinks. Almost at the halfway mark in the chase and South Africa Women are a bit behind the eight ball. They need 69 runs off 63 balls which isn't a big ask but on this pitch it is. The Indian spinners have bowled well till now but Sune Luus and Chloe Tryon are doing well with the counter-attack at the moment. An exciting passage of play awaits as Harmanpreet Kaur goes off the field.
Fuller outside off, Chloe Tryon drives it to covers.
Drifter outside off, Sune Luus goes back and runs it to short third for a quick single.
FOUR! Fuller ball down the leg, Sune Luus brings out the paddle sweep and works it through the fine leg region for a boundary. Excellent placement.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad (2-0-10-1) is back on.
Floated it on off. Sune Luus goes for the drive and gets an inside edge onto the pads for a quick single.
Good-length delivery on the fourth stump line. Sune Luus bunts it to point.
Off pace delivery on off stump. Chloe Tryon tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length delivery outside off, Chloe Tryon dabs it to cover.
Length ball shaping in, Chloe Tryon goes back and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Renuka Singh starts off with a length ball on off. Chloe Tryon goes back and bunts it to covers.
Tosses it up, and turns away outside off, Chloe Tryon punches it down to long-off for one.
Time for a bit of pace as Renuka Singh comes into the attack.
Tossed up down the leg side, Chloe Tryon goes for the sweep and misses but the umpire calls it WIDE.
Flatter, and quicker on off. Chloe Tryon goes back and bunts it to covers.
FOUR MORE! Short and outside off, Chloe Tryon reaches for it and hits it through the cover region for back-to-back boundaries. A misfield from the cover fielder allows the ball to go for four.
FOUR! BANG! Tossed up on off. Chloe Tryon uses her feet and lofts it to the long-off region for a boundary. Positive intent is shown here by Chloe Tryon.
Short and pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tad short on the leg peg, Chloe Tryon tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Devika Vaidya to have a bowl now.
Fuller and spinning away, Sune Luus goes for the sweep and misses it.
Quicker one outside off, Sune Luus goes back and chops it to point.
Drifter outside off, Chloe Tryon works it to deep covers for a single to get off the mark.
Chloe Tryon walks in at number 5.

GONE! BOWLED! Third one down for South Africa Women. Tossed up on the middle stump line and turning into the left-hander. Lara Goodall goes for the big swing across the line and misses it. The ball goes through the gap and cleans her up. South Africa Women are in a spot of bother as Lara Goodall walks back for 7.
Tad short outside off, Sune Luus runs it down to short third for one.
Fuller on the middle and leg. Lara Goodall chips it to deep mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! SMOKED! Fuller on off. Sune Luus lofts it over the mid-on fielder as the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. Excellent timing and placement.
Tossed up on off, Sune Luus goes back and defends.
Flatter outside off, Sune Luus cuts it to point.
Sune Luus, South Africa Women's skipper walks out to bat with her team in a spot of bother.

OUT! EDGED and TAKEN! Tossed up outside off, Tazmin Brits goes for the expansive drive and gets a faint edge to the keeper Yastika Bhatia who takes it brilliantly. South Africa Women lose another one as Tazmin Brits departs for 8.
